title: Titanium Valve Strainer Basket
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is engineered for Titanium Valve Strainer Basket where a combination of high specific strength, corrosion resistance, and non-magnetic properties is needed in energy extraction equipment. Its fracture toughness (KIC >75 MPa√m) provides defect tolerance in thick-section components under H₂S-containing well fluids. The alloy maintains >90% room-temperature tensile strength up to 200°C, suitable for downhole and geothermal service in Perforated valve strainer basket. This rationale is driven by perforated valve strainer basket and service environment demands.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for valve component geometry
CNC precision machining with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding all positions with 0.5mm corner radius
DPI dye penetrant inspect with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for perforated valve strainer application
inspection: UT volumetric full matrix (perforated valve verified)
commonFailures: H2 permeation at >100 bar pressure - reduced by ALD alumina barrier 0.5um on gas-wetted surfaces — critical for perforated valve strainer performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Valve Strainer Basket have?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Valve Strainer Basket is suitable for perforated valve strainer in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Valve Strainer Basket orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Valve Strainer Basket is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Valve Strainer Basket?
faq.a: Each Titanium Valve Strainer Basket shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for perforated valve strainer.
